title: Fix a broken Dockerfile
summary: The message box won't build, and once it does, it won't stay up. Find the three mistakes.

tasks.title: The image `message-box-fixed` builds
tasks.hint: Build from this folder: `docker build -t message-box-fixed .` When it fails, read the red lines: they name the Dockerfile line that broke. Two lines are misspelled. Compare each name with the files on the left and with the image name you've used before (`node:24-slim`).

tasks.title: A container called `box`, made from that image, keeps running
tasks.hint: Start it with `docker run -d --name box -p 8081:8080 message-box-fixed`. If `docker ps` doesn't show it, it crashed: `docker logs box` tells you why. Look at the last line of the Dockerfile. After a fix: rebuild, `docker rm -f box`, and run it again.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:8081/web` shows the message box
tasks.hint: The app listens on port 8080 inside the container. Your laptop's door is 8081, so use `-p 8081:8080`.
